steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation required by the case.
Allow the vendor to be added during event creation and permit publishing.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical + RFQ project.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the line item that will receive the vendor quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Invite one QA vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Commit the required 30-minute event schedule.
Publish the completed two-stage event.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Continue in the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the Technical round to verify RFQ-only clauses are not shown there.
Confirm the Required RFQ clause is absent from the Technical round.
Confirm the optional RFQ clause is also absent from the Technical round.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the stage-specific terms apply.
Confirm the Required clause is shown on the RFQ vendor screen.
Confirm the optional clause is shown on the RFQ vendor screen.
Accept the Required clause.
Keep the optional clause unaccepted and verify that state.
Submit the vendor quote with 100 for every line after accepting only the Required clause.
Verify that the bid was submitted successfully despite the optional clause remaining unaccepted.
